content:
maria: Heads-up — I'm starting a small rebuild of the runtime base image to remove curl/wget and switch to a minimal downloader helper. Want to coordinate RBAC/signing + KMS rotation impact before we flip canary.
cheng: Thanks — what's driving the change? vuln or size?
maria: Both. Found an outdated TLS lib in the parent image and we can drop ~60MB by removing extras. Also need to tighten runtime privileges (drop CAP_NET_RAW, set no-new-privs).
sam: Important: signing pipeline relies on the image-signer service account. If you change the artifact path we need to update the signer role binding.
jess: Oncall note: if the signer SA loses access during rollout we need an escape hatch to bypass automatic deploys to avoid service outages.
maria: Agreed. Proposed plan: 1) rebuild & test in staging 2) update signer RBAC to a new least-priv role 3) rotate cosign key (KMS-wrapped) with staged rollout 4) canary to a single region 5) monitor audit logs + SIEM rules
kevin: Question: rotating cosign keys will break old images' verify step unless we keep old key available for verification. We should document the verification keyset and retention TTL.
cheng: We can keep an old verification public key in the trust store for 30 days while new images are produced. The runtime will accept either pubkey A or B. Need to make sure attestation metadata carries key id.
audit-bot: :information_source: New policy: image-verification events will be forwarded to splunk index redwood.images (retention 90d).
maria: @sam can you prepare the RBAC diff? Wanted to remove broad cluster-admin bindings from the signer namespace.
sam: Yep. Draft diff:
```diff
- ClusterRoleBinding: image-signer: cluster-admin
+ RoleBinding: image-signer: role/image-signer-limited (create/read/list on secrets, pods for signing)
```
kevin: That looks safer. Ensure the role contains kms:Encrypt kms:Decrypt only via the KMS operator's service account, not direct KMS key access from signer.
sam: We'll instead give signer a credential to call the kms-operator endpoint which then performs cosign wraps. Prevent direct KMS key unwrap from signer.
jess: From ops side: when you cut the first canary, I'll watch for broken verifications and alert thresholds: 5% verify-fail rate or >30m continuous failures -> rollback.
maria: Vulnerability note: CVE-2024-XXXX in libssl was flagged by vuln-scan on the base image. We patched by rebuilding against 1.1.1y; also removed curl which used a deprecated TLS option.
cheng: Does the runtime need a compatibility shim? Some services expect curl binary. We should ship a tiny /usr/local/bin/downloader that wraps curl replacement and logs user agent.
sam: Add a fallback symlink during canary so scripts calling curl don't crash. We'll remove symlink in the final cut.
kevin: Audit logging change: need to ensure image-pull and cosign-verify events include user/service account, key-id, and image-digest. Splunk team needs those fields for correlation.
audit-bot: :white_check_mark: Forwarding rule updated: fields added -> user, sa, key_id, image_digest.
maria: Testing checklist posted to staging channel shortly. Quick test commands:
```bash
# verify image locally
cosign verify --key $PUBKEY image:sha256:abcd
# simulate old-key verify
cosign verify --key $OLD_PUBKEY image:sha256:abcd
```
cheng: One more runtime hardening ask: enable seccomp default deny and only allow a small syscall list for worker containers. That may break some legacy libs. We should run the seccomp profile in permissive mode in staging first.
jess: We'll add a runtime metric seccomp.permissive.rejects and an alert if >100 rejects/min during canary.
sam: For the KMS rotation: plan is to create new key in KMS, wrap cosign private key, publish new public key, update verification trust, then retire old wrap after 30d. Need to schedule a key-rotation maintenance window with infra.
kevin: Also note: compliance wants the rotation log exported to the audit bucket with signatures. Add an audit entry when we rotate.
maria: I'll open a Jira for the rebuild > REBUILD-2217 and tag the RBAC and KMS tasks. Want to cut staging build in ~2 hours if no objections.
cheng: Quick Q: will the new image change UID/GID layout? If so, we must update file permissions for mounted volumes.
maria: No UID change, only remove binaries and tweak entrypoint.
sam: I pushed the RBAC PR link: https://git.internal/rbacs/PR-452 - please review.
kevin: Reviewed and left comments about scoping secrets:get to the specific signing secret only.
jess: Oncall will standby for canary today 1600-2000 PT. Ping me when you start.
maria: Starting staging build now. Will post logs here.
[5m later]
maria: build ok, pushed image sha256:9f3a1. Running cosign verify with both keys succeeded. Staging deploy started.
cheng: Staging seccomp permissive logs: a few rejects from an old native lib (glibc call). Working on a patch to stop the call.
jess: Staging verify-fail rate 0.2% for the last 10m — mostly from a flaky pull in eu-west. Not related to signing.
kevin: Splunk events look good, key_id present and matches new key. Audit export scheduled.
sam: RBAC merged. signer now uses role/image-signer-limited and calls kms-operator endpoint.
maria: Thanks team. Next: schedule production canary after 48h of no regressions. If anything spikes, we'll revert image tag and re-enable old signer binding. :thumbsup:
kevin: Add runbook snippet in the Jira for rollback steps (how to rebind old signer role + re-add old key verification).
maria: Will do. Closing thread for now, will reopen if prod canary starts.
